breakdown.description: The slab-containing steps are allowed to spin polarize even though the required setup is `ISPIN = 1`.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification enforces `ISPIN=1` in the single INCAR used for all three optimization steps, including slab-containing surface and adsorbed systems. It does not repeat the incorrect allowance for spin polarization.

breakdown.description: The slab calculations are allowed to relax the cell even though the required setup is `ISIF = 2`.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification sets `ISIF=2` in the INCAR applied consistently across slab calculations, so cell relaxation is not allowed. It does not retain the incorrect instruction permitting slab cell relaxation.
